description: The national urban railway station standard data (전국도시철도역사정보표준데이터) is a public standard dataset on Korea's Public Data Portal, provided by Korea National Railway's Railway Industry Information Center under the Urban Railway Act and the special act on metropolitan transport, with the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport as the responsible ministry. It lists the urban and metropolitan rail stations managed by local governments, urban railway corporations and KORAIL, including stations designated as metropolitan railway. For each station it gives station number, station name, line number and line name, English and Chinese station names, whether it is a transfer station and the transfer lines, latitude and longitude, operator, road address, telephone number and the data reference date. The current file (reference date 2024-12-31) is an XLSX of 1,073 rows, downloaded from the Rail Portal (data.kric.go.kr); the entry was registered on 2021-10-28, modified on 2025-12-05, is updated yearly, and the next registration is planned for 2026-12-20. Coverage is national. Licence and cost: free, with no restriction on the permitted use as stated by the portal. Caveats: blank values mean the item was not collected; the page is in Korean. Simulation uses: station locations and transfer structure for transit network models, accessibility and disruption studies. Related records: complements the KORAIL railway data portal and the Korea Transport Database.
